        # horizontal object components are placed at the lowest available rows.
        seen = set()
        objects = []
        for r in range(h-1):
            for c in range(w):
                v = grid[r][c]
                if v == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
                comp={(r,c)}; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h-1 and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==v:
                            seen.add(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
                objects.append((v,comp))
        # Drop objects in their original vertical ordering, preserving rows occupied
        # by objects in each column. Objects in the demo are rigid color shapes.
        objects.sort(key=lambda z: max(r for r,c in z[1]), reverse=True)
        for v, comp in objects:
            dr=0

                nxt={(r+dr+1,c) for r,c in comp}
